target.title: feat: summarize close candidate quality
target.body:
﻿## What Problem This Solves

Apply can have a valid queue of close candidates, but maintainers only see a flat list/count. That makes very different situations look the same: straightforward implemented-on-main closes, PR duplicate closes that still need coverage proof, policy-sensitive candidates, stale/low-signal cleanup, and candidates that are only retrying after an earlier guard skip.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Adds `proposed-item-quality-summary`, a reporting-only workflow utility that reuses the same close-candidate selector as `proposed-item-numbers`.
- Groups selected candidates into operator-facing buckets: implemented-on-main, duplicate/superseded, needs PR close proof, aging/low-signal, policy-sensitive, retry after guard skip, and other.
- Computes the mix after the apply step reconciles live closed/reopened records, so the status describes the same post-reconcile record tree used by apply selection.
- Adds the summary to apply status detail as `Close candidate mix: ...` for close-mode runs.
- Keeps the dashboard quiet: this only enriches existing apply status text and does not create a new alert/card.
- Documents that the buckets are telemetry only and do not change candidate eligibility, limits, live-state checks, or policy gates.

## User Impact

Maintainers can quickly tell what kind of pruning work the apply lane is about to attempt. The status stays concise and action-oriented, for example:

```text
Close candidate mix: 1 implemented-on-main, 1 needs PR close proof, 1 aging/low-signal
```

## Evidence

Focused local proof after addressing ClawSweeper review feedback and rebasing onto current `origin/main` including #398:

```powershell
pnpm run build:all
node --test test\repair\workflow-utils.test.ts test\sweep-workflow.test.ts
pnpm run format:check
```

Result: passed. The focused test run reported 65 tests, 64 passing, 1 skipped. The workflow test now asserts reconcile runs before `proposed-item-quality-summary`, and the quality summary runs before `proposed-item-numbers` selection.

Direct CLI proof from a temporary records tree:

```text
candidate_quality_total=6
candidate_quality_summary=1 implemented-on-main, 1 duplicate/superseded, 1 needs PR close proof, 1 aging/low-signal, 1 policy-sensitive, 1 retry after guard skip
candidate_quality_buckets_json=[{"bucket":"ready_implemented","count":1,"label":"implemented-on-main","next_step":"Live-state checks can close these if the item is still unchanged."},{"bucket":"duplicate_or_superseded","count":1,"label":"duplicate/superseded","next_step":"Confirm the canonical or superseding item is still valid before close."},{"bucket":"needs_pr_close_coverage","count":1,"label":"needs PR close proof","next_step":"Run or reuse close-coverage proof before closing the PR."},{"bucket":"aging_or_low_signal","count":1,"label":"aging/low-signal","next_step":"Rely on stale-age and live-state checks; inspect if this bucket dominates."},{"bucket":"policy_sensitive","count":1,"label":"policy-sensitive","next_step":"Close only when the explicit policy gate remains enabled."},{"bucket":"retry_after_guard_skip","count":1,"label":"retry after guard skip","next_step":"Retry only after the previous guard condition has been rechecked."}]
```

Current repository records smoke:

```powershell
pnpm run --silent workflow -- proposed-item-quality-summary --target-repo openclaw/openclaw --apply-kind all --apply-close-reasons all --stale-min-age-days 60 --min-age-days 0 --min-age-minutes 0 --batch-size 300
```

Result: passed and reported `candidate_quality_summary=no close candidates` for the checked-in records.

Full local check:

```powershell
$env:PNPM_BIN='C:\Users\marti\AppData\Local\Corepack\shims\pnpm.cmd'
pnpm run check
```

Result: passed. The full check reported 1148 tests, 1147 passing, 1 skipped, coverage gates at 100%, and format clean.

Codex review:

```powershell
codex review -c service_tier='fast' --base origin/main
```

Result: no actionable correctness issues found. The review noted the new quality-summary telemetry follows the existing candidate selection path.

## Screenshots / Visual Proof

No new dashboard card or noisy alert surface is added. The visible operator surface is the existing apply status detail text shown above.

## Dependency / Stack Note

This is based on current main after #391, #397, #395, and #398. It is conceptually independent from #401, but it touches the same apply workflow/status area; if #401 lands first, this branch may need a small rebase to preserve all status text.

## Risk Notes

- Reporting only: no new close/comment/label/merge behavior.
- Uses the existing candidate selector so the bucket counts cannot include records that apply would not consider.
- Computes after reconcile so closed/reopened records are reflected before the status is published.
- Does not change close limits, cursor behavior, live-state checks, policy gates, or permissions.
